note: Curated catalog of well-known Model Context Protocol servers. Most are the official @modelcontextprotocol reference servers (npx) or community python servers (uvx). Entries marked with env_required need credentials supplied at install time. Commands run as local processes under the operator's account — review before installing.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read, write, and search files within an allowed directory. The path argument is the sandbox root the server is permitted to touch.
servers.args_hint: Replace /tmp with the directory the server may access.

servers.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
servers.description: A persistent knowledge-graph memory store the model can write entities and relations into and recall across turns.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: A scratchpad tool for structured, revisable step-by-step reasoning. Lets the model branch and revise a chain of thoughts.

servers.name: Fetch (Web)
servers.description: Fetch a URL and return its content converted to markdown for the model to read. Good for grounding on live web pages.
servers.args_hint: Requires uv/uvx installed (Python). Try `pip install uv` if missing.

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Read, search, and inspect a local git repository — status, diff, log, blame — as tools.
servers.args_hint: Replace /path/to/repo with the repository to expose. Requires uv/uvx.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Interact with the GitHub API — search code/issues/PRs, read files, create issues — using a personal access token.

env_required.hint: A GitHub PAT with the scopes you want the model to use (repo, read:org, …).

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web and local search via the Brave Search API. Returns ranked results the model can ground on.

env_required.hint: A Brave Search API key (free tier available at brave.com/search/api).

servers.name: SQLite
servers.description: Query and explore a local SQLite database — list tables, read schema, run read/write SQL — as tools.
servers.args_hint: Replace the path with your .db file. Requires uv/uvx.

servers.name: PostgreSQL
servers.description: Read-only access to a PostgreSQL database — inspect schema and run read queries — for grounding the model on live data.
servers.args_hint: Replace the connection URL with your database DSN.

servers.name: Puppeteer (Browser)
servers.description: Drive a headless Chromium browser — navigate, click, fill, screenshot, evaluate JS — for live web automation and scraping.

servers.name: Slack
servers.description: Read and post Slack messages, list channels and users, via a bot token.

env_required.hint: A Slack bot token (xoxb-…) with the scopes you want.

servers.name: Everything (Reference/Test)
servers.description: The reference MCP server exercising every protocol feature — prompts, resources, tools, sampling. Use it to verify the MCP wiring end-to-end.
servers.args_hint: Handy for testing the platform's MCP integration with no external dependencies.
